# owner: platform
"""Contact sheet for substitute teachers."""

from typing import List

from rosterkit.errors import ProjectError
from rosterkit.models import Student

# ---
def contact_rows(students: List[Student]) -> List[str]:
    """Rows of name, section and email, sorted by name."""
    if not students:
        raise ProjectError("no students for contact sheet")
    for student in students:
        if not student.email:
            raise ProjectError(
                f"no email for {student.display_name}"
            )
    ordered = sorted(
        students, key=lambda stud: stud.display_name
    )
    names = [stud.display_name for stud in ordered]
    name_wide = max(len(name) for name in names)
    sect_wide = max(len(stud.section) for stud in ordered)
    return [
        f"{stud.display_name:<{name_wide}}  "
        f"{stud.section:<{sect_wide}}  {stud.email}"
        for stud in ordered
    ]
